fixes.no_repeated_book_name: Event titles are now the event name only (e.g. 'Audience With Artaxerxes'); the timeline rows and event chips render the range in same-book short form '2:1–8' via shortRange(), so 'Neh' never repeats for the same event.
fixes.remove_top_timeline: Corrected: the passage timeline rail is RESTORED at the top of the reader. The rail removed is the passage-scope selector (Segmented) at the top of the Passage Context sheet; the sheet now always shows the chapter context directly.
fixes.history_clicks: ContextFlow now closes the context sheet before opening the entity, event or timeline sheet, so a tap has a visible effect (sheets no longer stack). Event cards now render participants and places as tappable EntityChips instead of inert prose.
fixes.nisan_no_longer_navigates: The History 'when' chip that jumped to the timeline was replaced by plain WHEN text (testID context-when); it is no longer a control.
fixes.places_events_actionable: History places open the entity card; events open the event card; event participants/places open their entity cards.
fixes.passage_rail: Restored the era rail with curated stops; it shows same-book short ranges such as 2:1–8 and the event names.
